name: Sushi Kanesaka

alsoTry.name: Sushi Kanesaka Palace Hotel Tokyo
alsoTry.note: The group's branch in the Palace Hotel Tokyo: Hagi dinner course (crab, 15 nigiri and soup), lunch from ¥9,487, omakase from ¥44,275; prices include tax and service; books online or through a concierge

alsoTry.name: Aoyama Sushi Kanesaka
alsoTry.note: In The Aoyama Grand Hotel: Fuji course at lunch or dinner, Kiwami omakase ¥30,250, lunch from ¥7,865; prices include tax and service

bookingOpens: The restaurant doesn't take bookings from guests directly: book through your hotel's concierge, who calls the restaurant.
children: Guests must be 30 or older (the restaurant's rule for this Ginza shop).
